description: Defines a Flutter widget 'RideBottomSheet' that displays ride details such as distance, fare, payment options, and a request ride button; includes methods for showing payment options and requesting a ride.

classes.name: RideBottomSheet
classes.description: A stateless widget representing a bottom sheet for ride details and actions.

methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the bottom sheet, displaying ride info and actions.

methods.description: Displays the payment method selection sheet.
